decisions.reason: The adjustable quarter-pallet display sits at the heart of the announced display focus and needed little extra investment, so management persists with it even though it has not been visibly presented since 2019.
The pegboard-back display extends the core shelf range the firm has publicly committed to, and weak visibility can still be put down to pandemic-related disruption in retail promotion.
The eighth-pallet display completes the publicly communicated pallet-size range and runs on capacity that is already paid for, so dropping it would undercut the earlier decision.
The dedicated investment in wooden pallet production and the need to justify that material extension keep management committed, despite uncertain results and no visible presence since 2019.
The media display serves a shrinking niche, but it is close to the core offer and was visibly launched, so management keeps it for now and attributes its weakness to temporary market conditions.
